_about: Samples that the masking of the server (.NET) and of the collector (Rust) must give the same answer to (Q-27). A marker stands for a run of characters so that no real-looking secret is written here (a secret scanner would take it for one): <A:36> is 36 times a, <U:16> is 16 times A, <D:5> is five hyphens. A line break or a tab in a JSON line is the two characters backslash and n (or t): a secret may start right after it.

samples.name: private key with escaped line breaks
samples.input:
k <D:5>BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY<D:5>
MIIB
abc
<D:5>END RSA PRIVATE KEY<D:5> k

samples.name: plain text is left alone
samples.input: The token is a word, and a password needs care.
samples.expected: The token is a word, and a password needs care.

a plain address is left alone
